// dir: x
// want: x run: params come from get("text-markers"), not AnalysisContext.Params
// with: core
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/core"

func run(ctx core.AnalysisContext, get func(string) core.ParamSet) {
	params := ctx.Params("file-size")
	if get != nil {
		params = get("text-markers")
	}
	_ = params.Int("max_lines", 1)
}
